next_step: Procurement confirmed vendor selection (OnyxAI). Deal closed-lost. Archive account; keep contact for future on-prem roadmap changes.
lost_reason: Procurement mandated fully air-gapped on-prem appliance with no external control plane or telemetry. Redwood private offering requires some control-plane connectivity and cannot meet the customer's zero-egress + HSM/KMS appliance requirement.
notes:
Key points from engagement:
- 2024-05 to 2024-09: heavy interest — PoC requested for chat-ops & automated incident triage.
- Tech discovery: Umbra runs grid SCADA + proprietary telemetry; cannot have any outbound connections from inference nodes.
- Security: legal insisted on air-gapped VM/appliance, HSM-backed keys, and no external telemetry. Quote from Head of Security: "Zero egress is non-negotiable — no phone-home, no SaaS control plane."
- PoC summary: we ran a hosted/dedicated demo. Performance/LATENCY ok but deployment mismatch.
- Pricing: mid-six figures ARR estimate; procurement willing to pay for appliance but only to vendors who can deliver air-gapped appliance + on-site HSM.
- Competitor win: OnyxAI committed to a turnkey on-prem appliance and compliant HSM integration. Bird's-eye: lost on deployment constraints, not product fit.
- Sales sentiment: account stalled after legal redlines (Oct). Initial AE follow-up stopped after procurement chose competitor.
- Quote from CTO (10/28): "We like Redwood technically but it doesn't fit our regulatory deployment model."
timeline: 2024-06-02 - Intro call (Maya Chen). Discussed chat-ops use-case; high-level SLA ask: p50 < 200ms token.
2024-07-12 - SE runbook session (Rafael). Env: on-prem SCADA, strict segmentation. Rafael requested network diagram.
2024-08-20 - Demo (hosted flow) to engineering org; positive signal on accuracy and latency.
2024-09-18 - PoC kickoff (ff_2024-09-18_umbra_kickoff). Ran local containerized demo but still required control-plane for model updates.
2024-10-03 - Legal redline received: require no control-plane egress and HSM/KMS integration. Requested vendor to sign addendum.
2024-10-18 - OnyxAI vs Redwood procurement evaluation meeting. Onyx committed to on-site appliance.
2024-11-15 - Final procurement decision communicated: select OnyxAI. AE notified. Closed-lost.
additional_context: Umbra is a mission-critical energy-grid operator. Their procurement process is risk-averse; procurement and legal prioritized regulatory traceability and absolute network isolation. There is some chance in future if Redwood offers a certified air-gapped appliance with on-site HSM support, but timeline unknown.
created_by_notes: AE: Maya Chen. SE: Rafael Ortega. CSM loop-in late in process. Main reason for loss: deployment constraint. Keep contact open for roadmap; set 6mo watch for product changes.
